title: Graph and MCP
summary: This module provides core functionalities for building and executing directed graphs, along with tools for interacting with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

nodes.label: Graph Core
nodes.title: Graph Core Module
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental components for creating, running, and managing directed graphs, including nodes, graph definitions, and execution instances.

nodes.label: MCP Server
nodes.title: MCP Server Module
nodes.description: Provides functionalities for interacting with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, handling HTTP/SSE transport, and loading MCP toolsets and server configurations.

nodes.label: Graph Persistence
nodes.title: Graph Persistence Module
nodes.description: Offers mechanisms for persisting the state and execution history of graph runs, supporting both file-based and in-memory storage solutions.

nodes.label: Model Integration
nodes.title: Model Integration Module
nodes.description: Handles the integration with various AI models, providing a unified interface for making model requests and managing streamed responses.

nodes.label: Capabilities and Tools
nodes.title: Capabilities and Tools Module
nodes.description: Manages the definition, registration, and execution of various capabilities and tools that agents can use to perform actions and interact with external systems.

groups.label: Graph Management
groups.title: Graph Management
groups.description: Components responsible for defining, executing, and persisting the state of directed graphs.

groups.label: MCP Interaction
groups.title: Model Context Protocol Interaction
groups.description: Components facilitating communication with and management of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Dependencies
groups.description: Other modules that this module interacts with to provide its full functionality, such as AI model integration and agent capabilities.
